chapters.title: RAG: separate retrieval from generation
chapters.description: Follow a RAG query through retrieval, eligibility, reranking, context assembly, and generation, and separate index accuracy from useful evidence.

chapters.title: ANN methods: define the target before choosing the index
chapters.description: Define the exact neighbor task before choosing an ANN index, compare cosine, inner product, and L2, separate candidate discovery from Product Quantization score approximation, and compare the six core ANN families.

chapters.title: HNSW paper walkthrough: trace a 17-node search and build step by step
chapters.learning_question: How do the two phases of HNSW search and build play out node by node?
chapters.description: Walk through Abid Saudagar's visual trace of the HNSW paper: upper-layer greedy descent, a 7-step 17-node Layer 0 beam search, Algorithm 4 neighbor selection, and Redis tuning.

chapters.title: Hierarchical k-means: route through nested centroids with a branch queue
chapters.learning_question: How can an outlier pull a cluster centroid away from your nearest neighbor?
chapters.description: Build a recursive k-means clustering tree, trace why an outlier pulls a centroid away from a boundary neighbor, and recover the exact result with a branch-and-bound priority queue.

chapters.title: KD-trees: split coordinate axes and prune with query balls
chapters.learning_question: When does the query ball cross a coordinate split plane?
chapters.description: Trace axis-aligned KD-tree construction, apply the hypersphere-to-hyperplane pruning inequality, and derive why coordinate splits lose pruning power in high dimensions.

chapters.title: Annoy: bisect random point pairs and merge a forest
chapters.learning_question: How does a forest of random bisectors fix single-tree boundary misses?
chapters.description: Partition points with random two-point equidistant hyperplanes, combine multiple trees to prevent boundary misses, and traverse branches with a shared margin priority queue.

chapters.title: IVF: partition into Voronoi cells and probe the nearest lists
chapters.learning_question: Why can the nearest centroid hide the nearest vector?
chapters.description: Construct a Voronoi partition with coarse k-means centroids, trace why nprobe=1 misses a neighbor across a cell boundary, derive residual vectors, and quantify posting-list imbalance.

chapters.title: LSH: turn angular similarity into hash collisions
chapters.learning_question: How do random hyperplanes find near neighbors without learning the data?
chapters.description: Derive the random-hyperplane collision probability from the angle between vectors, shape the S-curve with K-bit hashes and L tables, and compare multi-probe LSH against learned partitions.

chapters.title: Chunking methods: preserve evidence boundaries before embedding
chapters.description: Define what a retrievable passage must contain, compare token windows against structural, semantic, hierarchical, contextual, and proposition splitters, and diagnose chunk-level retrieval misses.

chapters.title: Fixed-size and sliding-window chunking: bound token windows and overlap
chapters.learning_question: How much overlap prevents a boundary cut from splitting a two-sentence fact?
chapters.description: Slice token streams with fixed windows and stride overlap, derive boundary-straddling probabilities and index bloat, and verify exact span recovery in Python.

chapters.title: Recursive and structure-aware chunking: split along the document hierarchy
chapters.learning_question: Why split on headings and paragraphs before falling back to sentences and tokens?
chapters.description: Walk an ordered separator hierarchy from Markdown headings down to sentences, merge atomic blocks up to a token budget, and preserve table headers and section breadcrumbs.

chapters.title: Semantic chunking: detect topic shifts with sliding sentence embeddings
chapters.learning_question: How do sentence embeddings find topic boundaries when formatting is missing?
chapters.description: Smooth sentence embeddings with a context buffer, compute adjacent cosine distances, trigger topic breakpoints via percentile or standard-deviation thresholds, and enforce token guardrails.

chapters.title: Parent-child and hierarchical chunking: index small spans, return rich context
chapters.learning_question: How can you match a precise sentence without starving the generator of context?
chapters.description: Decouple small retrieval child chunks from larger generation parent sections, quantify how multi-topic chunks dilute cosine similarity, and deduplicate parent contexts.

chapters.title: Contextual retrieval and late chunking: cure coreference and lost document context
chapters.learning_question: What happens when a chunk says 'It grew 18%' without naming the company or quarter?
chapters.description: Compare Anthropic-style contextual prefix injection against Jina-style late chunking over full-document token embeddings to resolve pronouns, implicit entities, and scope across chunk boundaries.

chapters.title: Proposition and agentic chunking: decompose text into atomic self-contained facts
chapters.learning_question: When is a single sentence still too entangled for retrieval?
chapters.description: Decompose compound sentences into atomic decontextualized propositions, group related claims into thematic cards, and enforce provenance and lexical grounding checks.

chapters.title: Retrieval methods: match, fuse, and rerank evidence across representations
chapters.description: Design a multi-stage RAG retrieval pipeline across lexical BM25, SPLADE, dense bi-encoders, hybrid RRF fusion, ColBERT late interaction, HyDE query rewriting, and cross-encoder MMR reranking.

chapters.title: Lexical and learned sparse retrieval: score exact terms with BM25 and SPLADE
chapters.learning_question: Why does a dense vector miss an exact error code that BM25 finds immediately?
chapters.description: Score exact identifiers with Okapi BM25 term saturation and length normalization, expand sparse vocabulary weights with SPLADE, and prune inverted posting lists.

chapters.title: Dense bi-encoders: map queries and passages into a shared metric space
chapters.learning_question: How do dual encoders match paraphrases with zero shared words at millisecond latency?
chapters.description: Train dual-tower bi-encoders with InfoNCE contrastive loss and hard negatives, separate asymmetric query and passage prefixes, and truncate dimensions with Matryoshka embeddings.

chapters.title: Hybrid retrieval and score fusion: combine lexical and dense rankings
chapters.learning_question: How do you merge an unbounded BM25 score with a cosine similarity in [-1, 1]?
chapters.description: Combine sparse BM25 and dense vector retrievers without raw-score distortion using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and normalized convex combinations.

chapters.title: Multi-vector late interaction: preserve token-level alignment with ColBERT MaxSim
chapters.learning_question: How can you get token-by-token query-passage interaction without running a cross-encoder on every document?
chapters.description: Retain per-token embeddings, score query-to-passage alignments with the ColBERT MaxSim operator, and compress multi-vector indexes with PLAID centroid residuals.

chapters.title: Query transformation and HyDE: bridge the question-to-document representation gap
chapters.learning_question: What if the user's question looks nothing like the declarative sentence that answers it?
chapters.description: Decontextualize conversational queries, decompose multi-hop questions, fuse multi-query expansions, and project queries into passage space with Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE).

chapters.title: Cross-encoder reranking and MMR: refine top-k precision and eliminate redundancy
chapters.learning_question: Why retrieve 50 candidates if the prompt only has room for 5 passages?
chapters.description: Rescore bi-encoder candidate pools with full self-attention cross-encoders, calibrate relevance thresholds, and diversify assembled context with Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR).
